title: Control Plane capability resolution explanation
description: The privileged diagnostic that explains how the Control Plane resolved, or refused, a capability for a stored context (ADR-BCP-003 section 80, ADR-BCP-004 section 77, ADR-BCP-022 section 47). Unlike runtime resolution, which collapses every failure to a generic outcome, it names the stage the resolution reached and why it stopped. A definition library; validate against the fragment, e.g. capability-explanation.schema.json#/$defs/CapabilityExplanation.

opaqueId.description: An internal Control Plane record identifier, reported for diagnosis only.

context_id.description: A context the Control Plane resolved and stored earlier. The explanation runs against that trusted context, never an inline one.

CapabilityExplanation.description: Each record identifier is present only when resolution reached that stage. policy and topology are present exactly when the outcome is ROUTED. The explanation never grants access.

outcome.description: ROUTED when resolution selected an engine instance; FAILED otherwise.

reason.description: Why resolution stopped, or empty when it routed. Diagnostic text for operators; clients must not parse it.
